title: A unique sensory experience
text: It goes far beyond the typical wine tasting where we take sips of different wines while being told the characteristics we’re supposed to perceive. I experienced it as a sensory game, where we learn to train our sense of smell (the often-forgotten one) to approach wine in a different way - through our own perception- in a fun and very pleasant atmosphere among participants, and with a great dose of wine knowledge (Cris is an absolute expert in the field). 100% interesting and highly recommended for anyone interested in wine and in Mediterranean culture.
author: annanarcisodublann

title: A magnificent sensory experience
text: Right experience. You know wine differently. With a different approach than usual, transgressive, illustrative, didactic and entertaining. Helps you lay the foundations and understand the world of wine much better
author: Ramonmartaglio

title: A pleasant experience
text: Very pleasant afternoon learning to smell, value and taste different wines from the Mediterranean area. Pleasure for the senses.
author: isabeldJ726JQ

title: Unforgettable experience
text:
An amazing experience training our senses and sharing opportunities with the rest of the participants. Cristina communicates her passion and love for wine and its world on a way that engages you immediately.
This is an experience that you shouldn't miss. I'm looking forward to new sessions.
author: carlesf882

title: Memorable tasting
text: Splendid experience. Cristina guided us for the pleasure of wine in a memorable way. I especially loved your good judgment in the balanced selection of origins and harvests. I highly recommend this tasting.
author: josepa553

title: A different kind that inspires you to repeat
text: I had the pleasure of attending a wine tasting session organized by Cristina. I loved it. It wasn’t a taste like we’re used to; it was a different sensory experience, very well guided and creative. A different technique. Those of us who are passionate about this world loved the approach. We enjoyed an excellent class and a very creative group. We'll repeat, for sure. Thank you, Cristina, for sharing your know-how and accumulated experience in the world of work and sensory.
author: 18evaj

title: The best tasting experience
text: The best tasting experience. Participatory, fun and with a personal touch. Cristina is an expert in the world of wine and aromas.
author: Stay03200082967
